Caixa de Assistência dos Funcionários do Banco do Brasil (CASSI) faced significant challenges to optimize its authorization processes for medical procedures.The need to reduce review times and free the technical team to focus on highly complex cases prompted the organization to seek innovative technological solutions.
The partnership with Microsoft provided a transformation that resulted in significant savings in cost and improvements in efficiency.
Endrigo explains that the process took about eight months, from conception to going live.

Results and benefits of adopting Microsoft Azure The implementation of Microsoft solutions resulted in several tangible benefits for CASSI: Reduced review time: The time to review medical requests has been reduced from three days to seconds, allowing an almost immediate response.
Process automation: Approximately 10% of authorizations (about 12,000 per month) were automated, no longer requiring human intervention, which increased the efficiency of the medical team.
Cost reduction: There has been estimated savings of R$4 million a year, mainly due to the reduction of medical labor cost.

Conclusion CASSI's partnership with Microsoft demonstrates how the adoption of advanced technologies can transform traditional processes, resulting in greater efficiency, cost reduction, and improved quality of care.

They faced challenges in system integration and data automation.
The goal was to optimize the procedure authorization workflow to streamline the reviews and allow our technical team to focus on highly complex cases.

As reported by Arcilia Machado, CASSI's Technical Regulation Manager, “the goal was to optimize the procedure authorization workflow to streamline the reviews and allow our technical team to focus on highly complex cases.” A three-pronged transformation Overcoming these challenges would require a three-pronged action plan: Authorization automation: The need to automate manual reviews for authorizing medical procedures to streamline that process and free up the technical team for more complex cases.
Systems integration: Integrate different systems and platforms to create a continuous flow of data between the review system and the post-review processing system.

The solutions chosen were: Microsoft Azure Databricks , used for processing and analyzing large volumes of data; Microsoft Azure Data Factory , for orchestrating and moving data between different systems; in addition to Microsoft Azure Data Lake and Microsoft SQL Server for storage and transaction of historical data.
